draft.title: DNA, genes and chromosomes
card: DNA
a long molecule that carries the instructions for building and running a living thing. It is shaped like a twisted ladder, called a double helix.
Gene
a section of DNA that codes for a trait, such as a protein that affects eye colour. One DNA molecule holds many genes.
Chromosome
a length of DNA wound tightly around proteins so it fits inside the nucleus. Human body cells have 46 chromosomes, in 23 pairs.
So the order of size is gene, then DNA molecule, then chromosome. A chromosome is one DNA molecule coiled up, and a gene is only a small part of it.
draft.remember: Genes are sections of DNA, and chromosomes are coiled DNA holding many genes.

a.q: Which statement best describes a gene?
opts: A section of DNA that codes for a trait
A tightly coiled structure made of many chromosomes
A cell part that stores DNA in the nucleus
A whole DNA molecule that is wound around proteins
a.why: A gene is one section of a DNA molecule and codes for a trait. A whole coiled DNA molecule is a chromosome, which holds many genes, so that option describes the wrong structure.
a.clue: Think about which one is only a small part of DNA.

b.q: A scientist studies one human body cell and its nucleus. Which statement about what she finds is correct?
opts: Each chromosome is a coiled DNA molecule with many genes
Each gene is a coiled DNA molecule with many chromosomes
Each chromosome is a single gene made of coiled DNA
Each gene is made of many DNA molecules and chromosomes
b.why: A chromosome is DNA wound tightly, and it carries many genes along its length. A chromosome is not a single gene, because a gene is only one section of the DNA.
b.clue: Decide which is bigger, a gene or a chromosome.

a.best: A section of DNA that codes for a trait

b.best: Each chromosome is a coiled DNA molecule with many genes

problems.detail: The card says 'the order of size is gene, then DNA molecule, then chromosome', then that a chromosome is one DNA molecule coiled up. A chromosome is the same DNA molecule packed with proteins, not a bigger thing than it, so this order could mislead students. Better to say a gene is a small part of a DNA molecule, and a chromosome is one whole DNA molecule coiled around proteins.

check.summary: Both questions are sound and each has one clear right answer. The card's 'order of size' line (gene, then DNA molecule, then chromosome) could mislead, because a chromosome is the same DNA molecule coiled up, not something bigger than it.
